name: Horn Charger
prompt: Create ONE Charger slime enemy candidate for Math on Mars. Reference is the approved flat Drifter STYLE ONLY, not its shape or color. Charger is a basic charging enemy: WIDE SQUAT AMBER WEDGE body with simple shell ridges, distinctly broader and more armored-looking than Drifter and tall Spitter. Exactly one front-facing orientation, both eyes level, creature looks directly at camera; no three-quarter turn or side view. Organic jelly creature, no machinery, weapons or limbs. Dark navy determined eyes, one pale-yellow small belly core. STRICT FLAT COLORS: body uniform amber-orange, shell plates one uniform warm golden yellow, core pale yellow, outlines/features dark navy. No shading anywhere: NO shadows, gradients, highlights, glare, texture, glow or translucency. Express shell ridges using a few bold contour lines or large flat shapes, not lighting. Smooth simple cartoon illustration, thick clean navy outline, readable small-game silhouette. Single whole centered creature, generous margin, square image on SOLID BRIGHT BLUE background. No floor, cast shadow, dust, projectile, extra creatures, labels or text. Friendly cartoon menace, no gore. Design C: broad low amber jelly wedge with TWO SHORT BLUNT golden horn-like shell ridges on the outer crown corners, curving gently inward, central flat golden brow plate between them. Keep horns soft and rounded, no sharp dangerous points. Eyes symmetrical below brow, small pale-yellow oval belly core, wide two-lobed soft base. Strong charging silhouette with chunky organic armor and mischievous determined face; no mouth needed.
notes: Charger appearance variant, no animation or runtime integration.
